text:
kai: quick thought 1: what if we surface a tiny "priority gradient" bar left of each rule (subtle color ramp from high->low) to help scanning instead of big badges? thoughts on contrast/a11y?

lena: curious. visually that could help, but we need tokens for dark mode and high-contrast. also ensure the gradient isn't the only cue1: add the ordinal number as sr-only text.

omar: prefer a small number + faint gradient. if we rely on color alone we get support tickets. make gradient decorative with aria-hidden and ensure the numeric label persists in DOM.

riley: small UX add: inline help anchor for each condition field (question icon) to expand a compact examples popover. keeps inspector tidy and reduces clicks to docs. popover should be keyboard reachable.

kai: agree on popover. microcopy idea: "Examples: email contains 'acme.com', country == 'US', amount > 100" in monospace. show a copy button so users can paste example directly into the field.

lena: copy button is great. ensure clipboard permission fallback for browsers that block it. show toast "Copied example". add sr-only announcement.

omar: another accessibility note: reduce motion toggle for the priority gradient animations (we sometimes animate reorders). respect user prefers-reduced-motion.

riley: reorder affordance: keep small drag handle for mouse, but add Alt+Shift+Arrow as keyboard moves. after move announce polite aria-live: "Moved 'Block suspicious card' to position 4 of 10" and set focus to moved rule.

kai: undo pattern: toast "Moved 'X' to #4" with [Undo] inline. undo should also restore previous selection and focus. set undo window to 7s.

lena: preview: default button label -> "Preview rules"; add a chevron menu for sizes: Quick(1), Sample(20), Batch(100). default sample 20. show an estimated runtime chip next to menu.

omar: if sample >50 show a confirmation modal warning about run time and cost. also track analytics: preview_run.size and preview_run.confirmed.

riley: validation rewrite: instead of "invalid condition" show precise guidance: "Condition error: expected 'attribute operator value'. Example: user.email contains 'foo.com'" and a small "Apply example" quick action.

kai: last infra note: preview-runner supports sample_size but we need a query param for prefer_cached=true to re-run using cached sample seeds. will file a small API change request.

ui-bot: figma linked: https://figma.redwood/priority-gradient ; branch created: ui/ruleflow/gradient-help by lena. CI build queued.

lena: thanks all 1: i'll update frames and accessibility notes. if no blockers we'll aim for a small canary next week.
